data.name: BvB: Burglars vs Brats
data.detailed_description:
Burglars vs Brats is a team-based online multiplayer game where players compete as both The Burglars and The Brats in a game of Attack and Defend. Inspired by classic childhood movies such as Home Alone, The Goonies, The Sandlot and Kevin the Menace, BvB offers characters rich with charisma and unique skillsets.

BvB approaches gameplay from a less-violent approach, focusing instead on strategy, team-work and fun engaging moments without shooting or killing your opponents, as often seen in team multiplayer games. Teammates will need to utilize communication, coordination, and team-work to come out on top!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10
  • Processor: 4 hardware CPU threads - Intel® Core™ i5 750 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Video card must be 1 GB or more and should be a DirectX 11-compatible with support for Shader Model 5.0
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
